title: Barriers and Enablers For Oncological Exercise PREhabilitation in Head and Neck Cancer – The perspectives of patients and healthcare professionals
summary:
The aim of this study is to identify, from the perspective of patients with head and neck tumors and healthcare professionals, the barriers and facilitating factors for participation in exercise-based prehabilitation (the period between diagnosis and surgery) prior to tumor surgery. The findings will serve as the basis for the needs-based development and successful implementation of an exercise-based prehabilitation program for patients with head and neck tumors.
At the beginning of the study, we ask patients and healthcare professionals to complete a questionnaire. The questionnaire covers sociodemographic information (e.g., age, gender) as well as health behaviors (including nicotine and alcohol use) and occupational characteristics. In addition, we extract disease-specific data from the patient’s medical record, such as the date of the histological findings and the tumor location. This is followed by an interview, conducted either on-site at the clinic, online, or by phone. The interview lasts between 30 and 60 minutes. We are interested in the perspectives of patients and healthcare professionals regarding potential barriers and facilitating factors for exercise-based training prior to cancer surgery. The interviews are recorded and subsequently transcribed.

interventions.name: Patients with head and neck tumors who meet the inclusion criteria will be interviewed once (duration: approximately 30–45 minutes) and surveyed via a questionnaire
Healthcare professionals who meet the inclusion criteria will be interviewed once (duration: approx. 45–60 min) and surveyed via a questionnaire

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients
•    Diagnosis: Squamous cell carcinoma of the upper respiratory and digestive tracts, Stage III or IV
•    Tumor location: oral cavity, oropharynx, hypopharynx, salivary gland, or CUP
•    Post-surgery and/or post-radiotherapy
•    Sufficient knowledge of German

2.    Healthcare Professionals
•    At least 2 years of experience caring for patients with head and neck tumors
•    Professional groups: Physicians (ENT/oral and maxillofacial surgeons, radiation oncologists, medical oncologists, palliative care physicians), oncology nurses, physical therapists, sports scientists/therapists, psychologists, dietitians, speech-language pathologists
•    Sufficient knowledge of German
Exclusion criteria:
•    Age < 18 years
•    Lack of capacity to give consent
•    No written informed consent
